race.comment: INVERTATIONAL (5) is a tricky mare to catch but she's produced some career peaks this prep that can get the job done here. Gets in light with the claim and if the gaps appear she will prove awfully tough to hold out. HOWL (4) is his own worst enemy, forever leaving himself with too much ground to bridge. Will likely land in a tricky spot from the low draw but if the pace is genuine and a gap appears he will be humming late. ANOTHERHOUSE (7) was good fresh but failed last time in the slop. Drawn to go back from the wide gate but expecting a sharp bounce back third-up over a favoured track and trip. SILVER CHAOS (12) is ticking along nicely and the form around her stacks up. Drawn cosy and can make her presence felt.
